sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. I am Emily, your host.
Today, we visit Utrecht, a beautiful and historic city in the Netherlands.
The city is famous for its canals, bicycles, and old buildings.
Let's explore Utrecht together.
Part two, where is Utrecht? Utrecht is in the center of the Netherlands.
It is close to Amsterdam. It is easy to travel to Utrecht by train, bus, or bike.
The city is small, but very lively. Part three, the canals. Utrecht has many canals.
They are like small rivers that go through the city.
Along the canals, you can see cafes, restaurants, and old houses.
People sit near the water and enjoy the fresh air.
Part four, bicycles everywhere. In Utrecht, many people use bicycles.
The city has safe bike roads. You can see children, students, workers, and families riding bikes
every day. Cars are not very common in the city center.
Part five, the Dom Tower. The most famous place in Utrecht is the Dom Tower.
It is very tall, the tallest church tower in the Netherlands. You can walk around it and take beautiful
photos. The bells sound lovely in the morning. Part six, food in Utrecht.
Utrecht has many nice cafes and restaurants. Typical Dutch food includes cheese, pancakes,
fries, and street waffles, sweet cookies. People also drink a lot of coffee and tea.
The city has food from many different countries too.
Part seven, daily life. Daily life in Utrecht is calm. People go to work by bike.
Students fill the streets because the city is home to Utrecht University, one of the oldest in the
country. In the evening, people relax near the canal or meet friends at cafes.
Part eight, markets. Utrecht has lovely markets. The Radenburg market is famous.
You can buy flowers, bread, cheese, clothes, and fresh vegetables. Dutch flowers, especially
tulips, are very colorful. Part nine, parks, and nature. The city has many green parks.
One popular place is Wilhelmina Park. People walk, sit, read books, or have picnics.
In spring, the trees and flowers are beautiful. Part 10, architecture.
The buildings in Utrecht are old and charming. Many houses have brick walls and large windows.
Some buildings are from the Middle Ages. The mix of old and modern architecture makes the city unique.
Part a leather. The weather in the Netherlands is cool and rainy. Utrecht also has cloudy days.
People carry umbrellas and wear jackets often. In the summer, the weather becomes warm and pleasant.
Part 12, why Utrecht is special? Utrecht is special because it has peaceful canals,
beautiful old buildings, many bicycles, friendly people, great cafes, green parks.
It is a quiet and charming city in the heart of the Netherlands.
